summary: Understand what happens between a client request and a model response before assembling cloud services.
outcomes: Trace DNS, connection, request and response at a conceptual level
Separate authentication, authorization and transport protection
sequence: Draw client, server and trust boundaries
Follow a named host to an HTTP request
Define input and output schemas and status codes
Place identity checks at the service boundary
Inspect timeouts and redacted request logs

visual.question: Where did this request fail before the model ran?
visual.interaction: Inject lookup, connection, identity and schema failures into a fixed request trace

practice.task: Specify and test a local prediction service contract
practice.success: Error cases, identity scope and sensitive-log exclusions are explicit
